steps.text: November 26th, 1097, 9:33 A.M.
Wasteland vagabond settlement, 40km out from Caladon City
The Druid of Gododdin stands upon the barrens, silent and sedate, before a low mound.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: 'He cheated death.'

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: 'Wrested its most ready of victories.'

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: 'He left with pride for the place of his eternal sleep.'
She calls out, waving her staff.
The sun rises. This is but one more ordinary burial in the wastelands of Terra.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Here's the wine we agreed on.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: It's not very strong, but don't drink too much.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: What about Mae's bottle?

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: I want to pour it out here, where she's buried.

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: *Sigh*... Even though Quercus went through all that trouble?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Let it return to the earth.

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: You said you could brew it in three weeks... but never did we imagine that she wouldn't last that long.

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: *Sigh*... It's just the two of us now.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Alright, man, cheer up. Here's to Mae.

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: To Mae...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Yeah, to Mae.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Security in Caladon has been tight as of late, Quercus. We couldn't go inside to find you.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: I know it wouldn't have helped. The disease we have is incurable, and it was her time to go.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: It's just... the way she cried those last couple of days. It was hard to watch.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: *Sigh*... You've sent so many of us on our way. You know how much it hurts.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: She begged me to put her out of her misery with my Arts, but I couldn't do it.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Then... the next day, we found her at the bottom of the hill. She was asleep. Her eyes were closed. She didn't have to cry again.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: There wasn't anyone there. She didn't infect anyone, and she didn't bother any of us. Everything was fine. It was all good. I just thought it was...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: A little lonely, right?

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Yeah, lonely.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Here, another round.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Mmhmm.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Don't throw out the rest of the wine. Save it for the living.

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: Alright, if you say so.

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: Oh, right, the Catastrophe Messenger—Miss Elba. She stopped by a few days ago. Here's a letter she wanted us to pass on to you.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: A letter from Elba the 'Chaser?'

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: Right, didn't you ask her to help you look into how the Duke's encampment is doing?

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: We've been seeing quite a few army convoys heading north the last couple days. Makes you wonder what those bigwigs in the city are up to.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Whatever it is, it's probably no good... Be absolutely careful.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Anyway, I need to head back now. Whatever happens, take care of yourself.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Here's some medicine for you. It's winter now, and it'll only get colder. If you get chilblains, use some of this.

steps.name: Depressed Wastelander
steps.text: 'FrostNova'... What a funny name for an ointment.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: When will we see you again, Quercus?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Hmm... I'm not sure.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Alright, alright. I get it.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: If that's going to be difficult... mind if I ask you one last question?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Ask me as many as you want. We still have plenty of wine.

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Why are you helping us? The medicine's not cheap, right?

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: You often come to us wastelanders for information. Who do you work for?

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: We're just curious, we've known you so long... They say you probably used to be an officer in the military...

steps.name: Calm Wastelander
steps.text: Honestly, it doesn't much matter to us who you really are. We don't care for the righteousness of the city folks. You're helping us live longer, so we'll help you out, whatever it is you're doing.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: No, I want to tell you the truth, but I doubt you'll believe me.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: If I told you that there was a group of people who have been trying to save the Infected, would you believe me?
November 28th, 1097, 2:28 P.M.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: So the Duke of Gododdin actually took his forces to Londinium?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Yes, I'm sure of it.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: How big were his forces?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: The wastelanders saw at least two high-speed battleships sailing through. The Catastrophe Messenger also told me that she saw the siege troops leave their encampment too.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: That's bad news... All eight dukes are taking their forces to Londinium...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Anyway, I'll fill Captain Root in on the news.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Right, and I'm done with what Dr. Kal'tsit wanted me to take care of. Be extra careful with this document, please.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Here are the nomadic platform entrance permits to four dukedoms, and this is Rhodes Island's business permit for operating in Victoria.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: 'Industrial Waste Recycling and Processing'.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Couldn't we have just told them our usual line of business?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Victoria is especially strict with corporations that deal in Oripathy prevention, and each dukedom operates differently. It's too much of a hassle, so this is simpler. We need to get our foot in the door first.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Also, here's a letter from Lady Heidi. Make sure you hand it to Dr. Kal'tsit directly!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Understood. Don't worry.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: I'll head back to the town archives now... My coworkers are going to get suspicious if I disappear for too long.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Oh, right! There's one more thing I need to tell you.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: The place you were using as a hideout, the Green Spark. Someone burned it down a few days ago.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Captain Root's been waiting for you. You should head to the office soon.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: The shop was burned down? Why...?
November 28th, 1097, 3:15 P.M.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Captain, I'm back.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Oh, nice work out there, Quercus.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: 'Captain'?!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Susie!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Quercus, Mr. Root was your... captain?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: So this is where you were... I was so worried.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: You've been working for Rhodes Island...?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Hahaha... I... I'll tell you everything later.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: But perfect timing, Quercus. We have a severely infected patient in here.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: How are they?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: She's having an acute attack. Luckily, Susie got her to us in time.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: We're finished with the basic precautions. I'll leave the rest to you.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Okay, let's see.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Hand me the testing reagent.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: She's too weak. We need to give her an IV...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Quercus...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Can you cure Oripathy?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: No, I can't, and no one can. But Rhodes Island developed some medicine that can at least stabilize her condition and prevent it from worsening.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: She's very sick... but please. Don't give up on her.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Is she your friend?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: No, never mind. Everyone here in the Infected community is your friend.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Don't worry. She'll make it after she gets this shot. Her fever's caused by the inflammation, and I can control that with Originium Arts. That'll keep it from worsening down the road, and should help stabilize her.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: She also had some scrapes on her, which I took care of. She won't be in pain anymore.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: A-Are you alright?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Quercus... Green Spark is gone... All gone.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I know... *sigh*...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I was just about to ask you.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I haven't heard anything on my end, but do you have any ideas? Made any enemies?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Me? Enemies? No chance here. And Susie definitely wouldn't.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: There's been a lot going on in the city lately. The timing is uncanny. I couldn't help but wonder how everything's connected.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: A couple days ago, someone tried to kidnap a city councilor in the Infected community.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Who could be so bold?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Luckily, Skyfire was there, so things didn't take a turn for the worse.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Now the Guards are all clamoring that there are criminals here in the community, though they haven't done any additional investigations either.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I saw on my way here. They posted notices and wanted posters everywhere. They're even giving out rewards for tips.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Bounties for suspicious people in the Infected community too... You have to hand it to them.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: So you owned the shop... that they burned down...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Miss Haze!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Oh, she's awake.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Where am I...? Am I alive? Or is this what the afterlife looks like?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Yeah, you're alive.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: This is a Rhodes Island office... They're the ones who saved you.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Rhodes Island... I didn't expect they'd actually help the Infected...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You said 'they' burned down the shop... What do you mean?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I was being hunted by two thugs that night, and hid inside a place called the Green Spark. Didn't expect them to toss in a firebomb though.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: A firebomb?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Someone was hunting you down? Why?!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: No clue. Maybe because I overheard them talking about kidnapping some 'old councilor fart' and something about bombs? They probably wanted to silence me.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Wait! Back up!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: They were going to kidnap a councilor? When was this?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: And what's this about bombs?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: How... How many days was I out?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Today's November 28th, Miss Haze.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: So it was five nights ago... on the night of the 23rd.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: The day before they took those people to the factory...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: If you don't mind, could you tell me where you ran into those two thugs?
Some ten minutes later.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: This location on the map... Here, right?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: The buildings here have been left empty because of how close they are to the abandoned district.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Sounds like the perfect place to hatch a scheme.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Two Siracusans... Must be immigrants from there.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: And I doubt they're Infected if they didn't think twice before setting fire to a building in the community.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Most likely mercenaries, or thugs working for the mafia.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: If we know where they are, shouldn't we go pay them a visit?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I'd recommend against that.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: This is well beyond Rhodes Island's usual scope of business. We aren't here to keep the peace.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: That's true...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: But now that the Guards have a bounty out on them, we might just get a reward for turning over this information.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: It's not much, but it'll help pay for Miss Susie's losses.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh? Is that okay, really? Shouldn't Miss Haze get the reward?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Let's just call it my way of paying you back... for saving my life.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I was the whole reason your shop got burned down in the first place...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Oh... It's not your fault. If you'd hid anywhere else, they would've burned down someone else's house instead.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Besides, the one who saved you was an Infected worker named Red.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I don't think it's such a bad idea. Helping those two bastards get caught will blow off some steam, at least.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Thanks, Miss Haze... Quercus...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh? Don't rub my ears...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Why are you being so polite with me now?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: It's settled, then. I'll help you put a report together, Miss Susie. You just need to take it down to the Guard station.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: What are you looking at?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: There's a kitten across the street, sunbathing against the wall.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Are you jealous?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh... they broke a flower pot... ran away, too.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I'm wondering. When will you chase me out of here?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Once Rhodes Island accepts an patient who's having an acute Oripathy attack, we won't let them leave until their condition stabilizes.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I can't pay for treatment, you know?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: No need to worry.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Of course, there are options available if you want to continue your treatment afterwards. I'll fill you in on the details once you get better.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: By the way...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: If there's anything you want to discuss, you're free to talk to me about it.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: My little 'Big Hat of the Witch Forest.'

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I never expected to meet a survivor of the Witch Forest.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: The Witch Forest? You mean the organization that took in Infected Casters?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: That's them.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: If I remember correctly, five years ago, they refused to cooperate with the Duke, and so the Victorian Army...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Can we... talk about something else?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: No need to apologize~

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I made my peace with that a long time ago. I was even prepared to, well, bite the dust in this city.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Though, sometimes, I still do want to put up a fight. See more kittens.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Now that I think about it, if I didn't hide inside Susie's shop that night, those Siracusans wouldn't have burned her shop down.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Quercus? Are you back?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Good morning. What's wrong? You look exhausted.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: From the looks of it, the investigation was a success?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Those Guards are absolutely hopeless cases! How could they wash their hands of it after putting up all those wanted posters?! Are they just waiting for the suspects to turn themselves in?!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: And where did Grani go? I was hoping to ask her to look into the factory...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You'd better not count on Grani too much. Her status as a collaborating operator of Rhodes Island puts her in quite a tricky position.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Strange...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I didn't notice until just now, but the building where Miss Haze ran into those Siracusan thugs... is right next to the factory.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Huh? You're right!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Miss Haze, you said they used military-grade incendiaries to burn down Susie's shop, right?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Is something wrong?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: If I remember correctly, the factory is owned by Councilor Bishmer. They make military-grade weapons there, and it was shut down a month and a half ago for 'equipment maintenance'.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: But the factory was completely empty when I got kidnapped by those fake Infected! Did someone steal their equipment?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: The papers certainly haven't reported on anything like that.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Are you telling me... the thugs are working with Councilor Bishmer?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: We don't have enough evidence. It's too soon to make that conclusion...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: But... unless I'm mistaken...

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: The Caladonian Guards' Captain is Bishmer's nephew.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Right. I think I heard that from Grani before.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Susie... How long has it been since Susie went to the Guards?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: About three hours. She should've been back by now.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I'll go find her!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm going too!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Bring your comms! Stay in touch.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: This is getting out of hand.
The calm Rhodes Island Operator takes a close look at the maps on his desk and sorts out the many doubts in his mind.
Then, he takes out an oddly-shaped communicator from his desk.
What are you doing, Captain?! I'm at work right now! Do you know how many people there are at the town archives?!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Kazemaru, this is extremely urgent. Prioritize what I'm about to ask of you.
...Understood.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I want you to put together a list of addresses of the properties owned by Count Bishmer, as well as a diagram of the old underground logistics passages beneath the city. As detailed and as quickly as possible.
Got it. I'll take care of it right now.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Did you find her?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: No! The Guards said their captain went to the location with Susie, and they haven't come back yet!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Dammit!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Calm down. Think of where she could've been taken.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm thinking...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Captain?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Captain Root! What's going on?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Listen carefully. I've just compared where Count Bishmer's estate intersects with Caladon's old logistics channels.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: I've worked out the seven most likely tunnel entrances.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You think they took Susie underground?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: As long as he's not an idiot, Bishmer's sure to imagine Susie has people helping her out, so he's not guaranteed to silence her.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: They'll take her to where it's quietest, and least likely to be found.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: There's also a chance they're in the abandoned sectors, but earlier I found out the biggest of the tunnels runs under his factory, which explains where all the equipment disappeared to too.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: You two get going for now! If anything happens, I'll get in touch!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Now what?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: How about I sweep the south three entrances, and you handle the north four.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Not a problem.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Stay safe!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: You too!
November 28th, 1097, 8:30 P.M.
Susie opens her eyes, and realizes she's laid right on top of the ice-cold pavement.
The damp chilly air pervades all throughout the gloom of the vacant space.
A faint pain in the back of her head still hasn't left her.
To one side of her comes the sound of a quarrel.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: You lot are a bunch of useless nothings! How can you twist something as sure as this so badly?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: It's... I didn't imagine... we'd hit all these setbacks.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Why did that decrepit lizard Angst suddenly send a Caster to his event? Did you let the information leak?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: One of us has been causing constant commotion, I admit that.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: But... Councilor Angst had an honest flare-up of heart disease...

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: And that just HAPPENS?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Where... is this...?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Wha..! My hands! Why are they tied together...?)

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: All these machines... is this the factory?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: No... it isn't, are these... the abandoned logistics tunnels?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: What's even going on...?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I remember the Guards' Captain said he'd see the place with me...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: And then...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: My head's killing me...

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: We're in a fine state now. How am I meant to file for losses with the factory not blown up? Hm?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Then... maybe you could say a thief stole all the equipment...?

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Only imbeciles like you would believe that!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: An entire factory's facilities made off with overnight! That could only be the work of a traitor! Anyone would jump to suspecting me!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: And they'd be sure to come searching this way, with a theft on that grand a scale!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Once the Duke's people find everything right here, it'll all be over!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Just—hold on, you never even once told me why blowing up your own factory would solve things.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Is THAT too hard for you? When the City Council asks me where all the money they gave me went, I'd just say I bought the facilities, but then the Infected blew them up!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: After that, we make up the cash, and so be it if the factory's kaput because it wasn't mine anyhow! So long as I've got all this costly industrial equipment, everything is fine!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: But now it's not! It's all a wash!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: *Sigh*... What do we do about this, then?

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: What else?! Get to work quick, get all these things moved out of the city! We can't leave any evidence behind!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Couldn't we just move it back...?

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Think for one second! The entire Infected community has their eyes on us after that business! In what world do you just MOVE IT BACK?!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: The Guards'... Captain? Councilor Bishmer?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Oh! You're awake now?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Our kind Infected citizen.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: You've given me no end of trouble!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Wh... Why...?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Don't act stupid! Now confess, who told you everything you told me earlier?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Who are all these... accomplices of yours?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...So you... you were their...

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Listen up, I'm asking you! Who told you about those two Siracusans?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: And who's this 'reliable witness' in this report of yours? Tell me their name!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Speak!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (She glares furiously at him.)

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: You think you can give me LOOKS?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Ungh...

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Never mind that, it means nothing whether she talks. There's no time to waste. Get this place sorted out.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: But the problem is the people she has with her!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Hardly anyone can testify against us. We'll be fine once the Danton brothers get out of this city and never come back.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: What's important right now is how you stop up the cash deficit.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: And by the way, don't be violent in front of me. I get sick at the sight of blood. Drag her off elsewhere.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Not a problem.
November 28th, 1097, 8:32 P.M.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: It's hard to believe this is the place...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: It's too late to call for help now, with two dozen people here...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Forget it. Let's do this.
The Druid of Gododdin sprinkles a scattering of unusual seeds across the bare earth.
Her staff lets out a green radiance, and under the effect of her Originium Arts, the seeds rapidly bud, digging into the ground.

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Hey, you, Feline! What are you doing?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Ooh, you've got fine eyesight.

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: What's someone ordinary doing down here?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I'm in a hurry. Just come at once, everyone.

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: You're daft! Are you looking for a fight?
Massive vines, each at least as thick as a hand, shoot out from the ground and knock the ruffians to the floor.
From the ground, from the walls, from the supports, green vegetation sprawls wantonly.
The fallen mercenaries are quickly bound tight by plants, with not even a moment to shout.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Are your salaries worth continuing this fight?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Or will you make way and let me through?

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: ...You go on ahead, Miss. I never saw anything today.

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: Out, out! We're off the clock now!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: That's more like it.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: So it was... all of you who burned down my shop?

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Enough rubbish from you. Keep walking.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: For crying out loud, don't blame me. If anyone, blame yourself, for being so starved for a hobby you got yourself meddling in all this.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: But you Infected were never bound to live long anyway, so this'll do.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...You... You'll be paying for this.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: For being at death's door, you've got some bluster.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (She shuts her eyes.)

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: W-Why is the ground shaking?

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: What's happening? Is there an earthquake? What sound is that?!

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Wait... It's coming from above.
The fierce sound of an explosion arrives from overhead, the structural layer shaking across the entire abandoned sector.
The walls crack, and the rocking intensifies.
Immediately after, the explosion gives way to the rumble of the tunnel's collapse. Together with the tremors, the unbroken sounds of structures bursting draw closer and closer.

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: What the hell was that?!

steps.name: Guards' Captain
steps.text: Aaaaargh!!
Engulfed in the explosion's roar, the top layer of the subterranean structure collapses, dropping several tons of steel frame directly upon the head of the Guards' Captain.
The rumbling persists as concrete and steel supports rupture and subside, the whole structural layer thrown into chaos.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh? Wh-Whaa?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (I... I need to run!)

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Run!! It's going to sink!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: What on Terra?! The goods! The facilities, they've all been crushed!

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Save your skin first, sir! Get out of here!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: What's the cause of this? Is there a Catastrophe?!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: There's no end to the rotten luck today, I see! Blasted, damned...!

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Just leave it for now. Come on, sir, let's move!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: That Infected! She's escaped!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Which of you was it who bound her?

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: We can't let her flee! After her, all of you!

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: You really can run, you little bastard.

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: If it wasn't for you, we wouldn't be in this mess.

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: (Raises weapon)
A keen blade pierces out from the shadows. A simple yet powerful cutting blow. The ruffian falls to the floor in response.

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: There's more?!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Get running, Miss Susie!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: M... Mr. Red? What are you...

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Don't mind for now. Move, fast.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: A... Alright!

steps.name: Guards Member
steps.text: What are you standing there for?! After them!

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Still? We don't even know where the Count's gone!

steps.name: Guards Member
steps.text: Then don't go. I'll be happy to take your pay.

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Dream on.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: It's... It's a dead end now.
Before Susie's eyes, the firm alloy platform hangs fractured from the explosion. A broken bridge, at least a four meter jump, is seemingly the only way out.
Behind them, the voices of the ruffians and mercenaries cursing draw ever closer.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Now what...?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: These people love their work too much. Following us in these conditions...?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You've really got a knack for inviting trouble, Miss Susie.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Mr. Red, what are you doing here? And do you usually carry that blade?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I'll explain later when we get the chance.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Right now, I need to find a way to get you out of here.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: There's no shortage of people in the Infected community worrying about you.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: But right now...

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Sorry about this, Miss Susie.
The Infected worker lifts her up and tosses her over, like slinging a crate of goods.
The young Feline draws a clean arc through the air, and lands on the platform's other side.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...Ow, ow, ow... Mr. Red?!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Keep running upwards! Quick!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Hurry!
The collapsing framework fully blocks off the entrance of the tunnel as the figure of the Infected worker vanishes into its shadows without a trace.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Mr. Red...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...I can't stop here, I need to get out...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Did the earthquake... stop?)

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (What even happened outside?)

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Mr. Red... Is he still okay?)

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...There's no way on. It's blocked.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: How far away... is the surface still?

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Finally... argh, my giddy aunt...

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Oh, my back... good grief...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...It's you.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Brilliant. You made it out of there somehow, you Infected wretch.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Bastard, bloody scum of the earth, useless good-for-nothing.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: It's all your fault!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: It's all you blasted Infected vermin... My money!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Get out of my damned way.
A slap from the greedy politician hits Susie square in the face, all his anger taken out at once on the Feline girl.
However, the Infected in front of him shows no sign of cowering in response to the savage act.
She stares down the noble before her, the stifled depression and pain she had experienced for days on end now nowhere to be seen.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: That's the reason?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Your people burned down my shop for something like this.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: You'd go this far, hurt so many Infected, for something like this.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: All just for... money?
She slowly stands back up, no longer the timid Feline from before.
In this moment, only enmity and anger remain in her gaze.
Every last thing that happened these past few days, all because of the greedy politician before her.
Why should he not pay the price?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: All of this was so far overboard... just for money?

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: What are you doing?! Don't come near!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Keep away from me! You—monster, get out!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...I can't forgive you.
She shivers, electric sparks jumping about her whole body.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: You... someone... save me!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: You... infernal...
The young Feline clasps fast the councilor's neck, violent sparks crackling.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Aaaaagh!!! Help me! Aaghhh!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Now you're frightened! Now you're scared!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Spare me! I beg of you... don't kill me... aaaaghggghhh!!!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Whatever you want... I'll give you... aaaghh!

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Spare me! Just spare me!

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: What gives you the right... to destroy my life—what gives you the right...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: You... you...
The young Feline lets her unrestrained anger loose. Councilor Bishmer twitches and spasms under her Originium Arts, frothing at the mouth and gasping what could be his last gasps.

steps.name: Bishmer
steps.text: Urkh...
Behind her, massive vines suddenly surge out past fragments of concrete, their roots bracing the steel frames. The city's lights shine down through an opening, illuminating a silhouette.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Susie! Susie! Stop it!
The Druid of Gododdin hurries to embrace the Infected before her. The fierce sparks burn her skin, but still she holds on.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Calm down, Susie... it's me, it's over now...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...Qu... Quercus...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: It's alright, Susie, everything's over.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: People like that... aren't worth what you're doing. Let's go home.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Quercus... *sob*...

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: It's alright, it's alright now. I'm here.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Home... the Green Spark's... gone... go home where...?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Don't fret. Do you remember what I always say?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: 'Life always finds a place where it belongs.'

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Let's go, little Susie. It's time to go home.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Quercus... I... I...

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Ungh...
In the narrow interstice between soil and stone, lattices of steel, and constructs of forsaken material, a young Feline lets out a deep, low wail, a weight fallen from her back.
November 30th, 1097, 7:45 A.M.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Professor, I'm here.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Ah, good morning, Miss Mountbelan.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Ah, no, you're 'Operator Skyfire' now, I presume?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Good enough spirits to crack a joke, I see.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Here, turn that frown upside-down! I'm quite alright.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: You're in the hospital! I wouldn't call that alright!

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Speaking of which, how did everything shake out in the end?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: The City Council passed your proposal, even if you only gained a single supporter.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: That's worth celebrating, Miss Mountbelan.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Is it really, Professor?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: There's still old nobility against the Infected community, and they've all ganged up in private. The clashing's only going to worsen from now on.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Now they're just waiting for Duke Gododdin to come back. They've signed a joint letter asking the Duke to abolish your title and strip you of your noble status.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: It's VERY stacked against you.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Hahahaha...

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: I'm already a good 153 years old, Miss Mountbelan.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: I'm looking to retire next year, retreat to my little castle, and take up a bit of my studies.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Titles, status, authority.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Do you think any of that still concerns me?

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: If things proceed without much hiccup, you'll be back at Rhodes Island too, won't you? Send Dame Kal'tsit my regards.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I will...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I'm just worried for you somewhat, Professor.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Now, now, what's to worry for? Look at my rickety old body.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: I tell you, some things people go and say are all but pompous and, well, completely meaningless excuses.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: People are already too accustomed to lying with pretentious jargon. So the lies pile up, and as lofty as it was meant to be, the principle gets washed out in the process.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Miss Mountbelan, do you know why I pushed for that proposal for Caladon so?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: You mean, the reason all that pretention sticks around?

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Twenty years ago, a scientist named Janet Longfellow published an essay.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: She set forth this view: if we don't streamline and improve on our current Originium industry and its waste products, then the year-on-year buildup of industrial waste may bring about frightening consequences.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: At the time, Victoria's academic circles all turned their noses up at that, and the nobles wielded public opinion to unabashedly ridicule this fine scientist. In her anger, she left Victoria altogether.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: But in the last ten years, the amount of Infected in Victoria has accelerated at a worrying rate.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Times have changed, Miss Mountbelan. We have to face the issues that 'Oripathy' and the 'Infected' bring. Maintaining this status quo will only worsen things.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: 153 years, Miss Mountbelan. It's not common to see people live as long as I do, even among Savra.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: But a long life's a good thing. It gives you the chance to see firsthand the folds and changes of history, to learn from your mistakes.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: In my century and a half, I've witnessed the toppling of Gaul's majestic palace, the fall of Iberia's golden city.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: In the plains of Columbia, I saw for myself the destruction the Grand Duke's army wrought on the frontier territories. I saw the Columbians in their sharp, steep ascent over the wastes.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: If Victoria can't change, then in the end, it'll only be another Gaul.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: It's just as I've told you, Miss Mountbelan.

steps.name: Councilor Angst
steps.text: Times have changed.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: You're back? I thought the Guards would've been slower than that.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, no, if it isn't our honorary citizen, star of all the front pages.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Your picture was very decent in the paper. Who knew you could be so photogenic, Susie?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Was it very heavy, that meter-wide certificate saying you've the lay of the land? Did you get tired lifting it for the cameras?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Come on, stop being sarcastic with her.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: 'The City's Hero' though... that's pretty impressive, isn't it!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: What about that awful councilor, in the end?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Taken into custody!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Are the Guards still acting as normal, after such a big blunder?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's not that easy, obviously, but we'll have someone from the Mounted Police taking over the Guards soon.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: That sounds good, I'd think.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Shame we've still got no way to make up for li'l Susie's losses... Bishmer's assets all got seized by the City Council.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Do you want a sweet? I've still got plenty of flavors here you haven't tried before!

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Will the council really not give you a single penny? Nothing except a certificate? Oh, forget it, they've always been this way.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Come here, perk yourself up a little with something sugary. Your artifact smile on that photo looked like you could cry.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: I... I don't even know what to do at this point, really...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Think on the bright side! At least those evildoers are brought to justice now.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: I'll admit, I still feel so many problems are waiting to be solved... but this is as far as we're able to intervene.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Quercus, are you leaving?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: Mm. I'll be back in Victoria very soon, however.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Will you come back to Caladon?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: More someplace in the wastes than a nomadic city, I think.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: That's right, Susie, have you ever thought of bartending somewhere else?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You see, the Green Spark may be gone now... but there's still plenty of Infected who'll need a drink.

steps.name: Quercus
steps.text: You could hairdress too. I know a lot of people who do nothing but get into fights. Some of them have never been to nomadic cities before. Some of them never think about themselves.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Eh? Could I really?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Of course you could! There's all sorts of interesting people aboard Rhodes Island. You might as well go take a look, and not too many people are specialty hairdressers there in the first place.

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: Hahaha... I'll give it a try?

steps.name: Susie
steps.text: (Everyone's been talking about Rhodes Island... What kind of place is it, I wonder?)
November 28th, 1097, 10:24 P.M.
Underground logistics passages of Caladon

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Carry on, then. You were all mighty a moment ago, weren't you?

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: You! Who the hell are you?!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: My name's Red. Remember it.

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Who gives a toss about your bloody name? Get out of my way, or I'm going to be pissed!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You know, back in my Ursus days, they all called me 'Redblade'.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You might want to guess why.

steps.name: Hooligan Mercenary
steps.text: Stay cool, boys! We're not easy to bring down either!

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: That's right, he's all alone! It's just Originium bloody Arts!
He's far from alone.

steps.name: Boil Brawler
steps.text: What?! Where did you lot sneak out from?!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Now there's a nice reaction. You sure don't act like this when you're shoving the Infected about.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Come on. Show me if you're really as mighty as you say.
The blade in the Infected's hands is ignited in a blink, surrounded by blazing embers.
The red-hot glow illuminates the rubble; the stone and steel ruins are bathed in the clear hue of fire.
And its source, the youngster bearing the searing blade, begins his attack.
